item.title: Tatonut announces temporary schedule change
item.description: OCEAN SPRINGS, Miss. (WXXV)- An iconic South Mississippi donut shop is making a temporary schedule change. Tatonut will be closed on Sundays for the time being. This is a temporary move as the owners grow the shop’s production team. The hours moving forward will be 5:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Tuesday through Saturday. Categories: Featured, Local News

item.title: Diamondhead Fire Chief celebrates 30 years of service
item.description: DIAMONDHEAD, Miss. (WXXV)- The Diamondhead Fire Department is congratulating their chief for a milestone. Chief Mike Munger is celebrating 30 years of service this month. Chief Munger had dedicated all 30 years to Diamondhead and operated at each level in the department. The department says they are thankful he continues to serve the community. Categories: Local News
